sources.source_name: Surrey County Council Local Government Reorganisation Hub
sources.source_type: Surrey County Council official reorganisation page
sources.evidence_text: The official page describes replacement of Surrey's existing councils by the new East Surrey and West Surrey unitary councils from April 2027.

sources.source_name: Surrey County Council Final Local Government Reorganisation Plan
sources.evidence_scope: Proposed East and West electoral structure
sources.evidence_text: The official plan describes 36 East Surrey electoral divisions with 72 councillors and 45 West Surrey electoral divisions with 90 councillors.

sources.evidence_scope: Legal establishment of East Surrey and West Surrey
sources.evidence_text: The draft order describes establishment of East Surrey and West Surrey as new unitary local-government areas, but is not a ward-to-division crosswalk.
